test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

I did not ______ that he would ______ the offer.
solution:
The correct answer is '**expect; accept**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**expect**' means to anticipate or think that something will happen.
 
• The word '**accept**' means to agree to something or receive it willingly.
 
• Option 4, '**expect; accept**' is the correct choice as it fits the context of the sentence appropriately.
 
• Other options such as 'except', 'bake', 'bate', etc., do not fit the intended meaning and grammatical structure of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I did not expect__ that he would __accept__ the offer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Except**: means to exclude something.
 
• **Bake**: means to cook something in an oven.
 
• **Bate**: is an archaic term meaning to lessen or diminish.
